representative.constant_heat_capacity_scope: Chosen integrated thermal-mass comparison over5–85K. Actual temperature-dependent solid heat capacity and adsorption heat should replace it.
representative.thermal_source_rule: Regeneration heat can be supplied from the200K waste reservoir. In that case its removal and later return cancel in the whole-station cold balance; only refrigeration work is an extra electrical load. If electrical heating is chosen instead, add the separately listed regeneration-heating power too. Regenerated He is isolated and compressed into product storage.

scope: No loaded cryopanel speed or regeneration lifetime is claimed by this thermal-mass exercise. The reference load is a low-load graph scale, not ultimate capacity.
Two isolated banks permit one to capture while the other releases gas into a closed product manifold. Valves and thermal switches must isolate the warm bank from the cavity-facing path.
The assumed cycling heat capacity does not determine total installed mass; noncycling structure can remain cold.
Gas sensible cooling, surface adsorption heat, valves, conduction, supports and refrigerator hardware are separate named requirements.
